name: octelium
description: Official Octelium skills: install Clusters (single-node quick installer or production Kubernetes), operate them with octops, manage resources and Policies with octeliumctl, and connect to Services with the octelium client.

interface.shortDescription: Install, operate, manage and connect to Octelium Clusters
interface.longDescription: Workflow skills for the Octelium zero trust secure access platform: the single-node quick installer, production installation on Kubernetes with octops, Day-2 Cluster operations (upgrades, TLS certificates, diagnostics), declarative resource and Policy management with octeliumctl, and client-side access with the octelium CLI.
